title: Watermelon-Lime Agua Fresca with Mint
summary: Watermelon is blended with water and strained, then seasoned with lime juice, honey and a pinch of salt and served over ice with mint.

ingredients.note: about 2 tbsp; adjust to the melon

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
mint sprigs and lime wheels, to serve

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the watermelon and water for about 30 seconds, until completely smooth.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Pour through the sieve into the pitcher, stirring gently so the juice runs through. Discard the pulp.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir in the lime juice, honey and salt until dissolved. Taste: a sweet melon may need no more honey, a pale one a little more lime and honey. The pinch of salt makes the melon taste sweeter.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, until cold. It separates on standing, so stir before pouring.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour over ice and finish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.

tips: Choose a heavy melon with a creamy yellow patch where it rested on the ground.
Don't over-blend seeded melon; crushed seeds make it bitter.
Strain through a fine sieve for a clear drink or skip straining for a pulpy one.
Freeze cubes of watermelon to use as ice.
storage: Best within 1 day; keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
